slides.title: why do you drop your price before they even ask?
slides.body:
for anyone who hears their own voice
go quiet when they say the number.

most discounts happen in our heads.

we guess the client will push back,
so we push back for them.

try this before the next call.

write your price on paper.
one number, no range.

keep it in front of you.

say the number.
then stop talking.

the silence after it is *their turn,
not a sign you got it wrong.

slides.title: decide the price before the call, not during it.
slides.body:
